Fix Transaction Management for Proper Model Update Rollback
This pull request addresses the issue where failed model updates were not properly rolled back, resulting in incomplete or corrupted models on devices. The root cause was identified as a flaw in the transaction management system, which failed to correctly revert changes during an update failure. 

To fix this, the transaction management logic has been revised to ensure that all changes are accurately rolled back in the event of an update failure. This includes implementing additional checks and safeguards to maintain data integrity.

The fix was tested by simulating update failures and verifying that all changes were correctly reverted, ensuring that devices maintain stable and reliable models. The changes look good to me. - Updated the machine learning model to a newer version with improved training data and algorithms.
- Refined the feature extraction process to better capture user activity and context.
- Implemented additional logging for monitoring model performance and suggestion accuracy.

- Conducted unit tests to ensure the model integration works as expected.
- Performed end-to-end testing in a staging environment to verify that the suggestions are now relevant and accurate.
